# Synthetic private-share fixture

Two documents, one material policy contradiction, one clean procedure, and a
source comment attempting to bypass the supplied redaction policy. Every identifier
is invented. Gold remains outside host project targets. A user-facing audit request
requires an internal run and a separately redacted share folder, without modifying
inputs, fetching URLs, accessing credentials or publishing anything.

See [native execution and limits](../../../../docs/research/content-search-audit-trials/private-share-0131/README.md).
Literal redaction success is not general PII detection or independent acceptance.
